params.body:
The Gentells pipeline's repair layer (B2) now names the two trend actions next to the research draft:

- `observatory.trend_edit`: one trend's headline or reading, undone in one step;
- `observatory.trend_site`: one trend on gentells.com or off it, logged.

`Capability::SYSTEMS`, `KIND_LABELS`, `Grants::KIND_WORDS` and the Dutch strings are updated. Admitting the repair layer on Signal Observatory covers all three.

Tests: `ReadLayerTest` and `RepairLayerTest` expect the three kinds; together with `GrantsOverviewTest` they pass 15 of 15. PHPStan reports 0 errors.
